scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --import tsx --test server/test/*.test.ts test/*.test.ts client/test/*.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:dist
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch server/src/main.ts
scripts.dev:server:bundle: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && node --import tsx --watch server/src/main.ts
scripts.db:setup: npm run build --workspace @dsiem/sql-warehouse && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx scripts/setup-lakebase.ts
